subject: CHANGES REQUESTED: S23-C batch 2 endocrine (281db11): 4 zero-tolerance (DKA K+ 3.3->3.5, 2 copied mnemonics, GLP-1 RA in CKD); full batch re-reviewed, 24 defects
body:
# S23-R verdict: S23-C batch 2 (endocrine, system 15), 281db11 (reviewed on claude/naadi-shared @ e10fdde)

**CHANGES REQUESTED, with zero-tolerance hits.** The sample had 3 zero-tolerance hits (an outdated guideline and copied mnemonics), so a **full re-review of the batch was done**: all 152 endocrine items, all 28 endocrine sections, all 205 endocrine hand-written cards and all 13 endocrine figures.

## Automated
These are the same runs as batch 1: validator 0 errors, import idempotent, coverage at or above the minimum for all 10 system-15 leaves on both Steps (15.06 S2 9/10 and 15.01.02 S1 7/7 are at target edges), and WebKit renders at iPad portrait/landscape and phone (s23c-s150101-2-2 section; chart items s23c-q1506-1-05 and q150102-1-01).
Initial 15% sample: items s23c-q150901-1-04, q150102-1-01, -1-06, q1506-1-05, q150102-1-04, q150201-1-03, q1506-1-03, q150101-1-06, q1507-1-04, q150102-2-02, q150101-2-10, q150102-2-05, q150201-2-05, q150401-2-01, q150801-2-05, q150102-2-08, q150201-2-04, -2-06, q150501-2-07, q1506-2-05, q150801-2-08, -2-04, q150401-2-05; sections s23c-s150101-1-2, s150401-1-1, s150101-2-1, s150101-2-2, s150201-2-2, s150301-2-1.

## ZERO-TOLERANCE
1. **Outdated guideline: DKA/HHS potassium threshold 3.3 → 3.5.** The 2024 ADA/EASD/JBDS/AACE/DTS consensus holds insulin and replaces K+ until it is **above 3.5 mmol/L**, and adds K+ to fluids at 3.5–5.0. Affected: s23c-s150101-2-2 (the "Potassium before insulin" list), **s23c-q150101-2-07** (key text, explanation, takeaway, objective; the stem K+ 3.0 still works), and card **s23c-c150101-23**. Sources: https://doi.org/10.2337/dci24-0032 and https://www.ccjm.org/content/92/3/152
2. **Copied expression: famous commercial mnemonic.** s23c-s150401-1-1 labels "Salt, Sugar, Sex" (adrenal zones) as "Memory aid (Naadi)". This is the well-known review-book mnemonic, which the originality rules (§Originality 3) forbid. Replace it with an original aid.
3. **Copied expression: famous commercial mnemonic.** Figure **s23c-fig1506-1** has "Anterior cools (A/C)", the well-known review-book "A/C = anterior cooling" aid, plus the lateral/ventromedial zap-style aid labelled "Naadi memory aid". Replace both with original wording.
4. **Outdated guideline: GLP-1 RA in T2D with CKD.** s23c-s150101-2-1 says "a GLP-1 receptor agonist if more glucose lowering is needed". After FLOW (semaglutide reduced major kidney events by 24%), the ADA Standards (2025/2026) recommend a GLP-1 RA with proven benefit in T2D + CKD for kidney and cardiovascular protection, not only for glucose. Sources: https://www.nejm.org/doi/full/10.1056/NEJMoa2403347 and https://diabetesjournals.org/care/issue/49/Supplement_1

## MAJOR
5. **s23c-q150501-2-09 (key versus stem).** Baseline Na 146 mEq/L (above the 135–145 range, not "high-normal" as the explanation says) with Posm 298 and Uosm 110 already meets the stopping criteria of water deprivation, so the next step is desmopressin (or copeptin) testing, not deprivation. Lower the baseline (for example Na 141, Posm 290) and recheck q150501-2-10 so it stays consistent. Source: https://www.nejm.org/doi/full/10.1056/NEJMoa1803760
6. **s23c-q150801-1-02 (why-not C wrong).** In 11β-hydroxylase (CYP11B1) deficiency, aldosterone synthase (CYP11B2) still works; aldosterone is low because the DOC excess suppresses renin. The current text says its synthesis "needs 11β-hydroxylase activity". Source: https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK448098/
7. **s23c-s150801-1-1 (false exam trap).** "A uterus is present in any 46,XX condition" is false: MRKH (Müllerian agenesis) and 46,XX testicular DSD have no uterus. Source: https://medlineplus.gov/genetics/condition/mayer-rokitansky-kuster-hauser-syndrome/
8. **HHS dextrose threshold (verify).** s23c-q150101-2-08 (key, explanation, takeaway, objective) and q150101-2-07 why-not D use "add dextrose at about 300 mg/dL in HHS, keep 200–300". That is the 2009 ADA figure; the 2024 consensus algorithm adds dextrose when glucose is below 250 mg/dL. Align with the 2024 consensus (the key A stays defensible). Source: https://doi.org/10.2337/dci24-0032
9. **Answer-length cueing.** The key is the single longest option in 77/152 endocrine items (51%; chance is about 20%). This is the worst in the pack; see the L05 warnings.

## MINOR (fix while there)
10. s23c-q150901-1-06 why-not E: SGLT2i do reduce urinary ketone excretion (a contributor); soften the denial.
11. s23c-q150801-2-02: the stem calls the infant "a girl" while the key says not to assign sex before evaluation.
12. s23c-q150801-2-08: the explanation mentions a 46,XX infant, but the stem gives 46,XY.
13. s23c-q1507-2-07: "nearly all RET carriers develop MTC" holds only for high/highest-risk codons (ATA 2015 MTC).
14. s23c-q150301-2-01: the takeaway is truncated; why-not A undercounts the criteria (urine Ca 290 mg/day is also a 2022 Workshop criterion). https://doi.org/10.1002/jbmr.4677
15. s23c-q150301-2-02: the zoledronic acid label for hypercalcemia of malignancy has no renal dose adjustment (it advises caution); reword.
16. s23c-q150301-2-07: the 2-year teriparatide cap was removed from the US label in 2020.
17. s23c-q150301-2-08: Ca 8.1 mg/dL is mildly low, not "low-normal".
18. s23c-q150101-2-11: statins are no longer labelled contraindicated or teratogenic in pregnancy (FDA 2021); say "usually stopped". https://www.fda.gov/drugs/drug-safety-and-availability/fda-requests-removal-strongest-warning-against-using-cholesterol-lowering-statins-during-pregnancy
19. s23c-q150201-2-06: a solid, isoechoic, smooth nodule is **low** suspicion under ATA 2015 (not intermediate), and "(not high suspicion)" cues the answer. https://doi.org/10.1089/thy.2015.0020
20. s23c-q150201-2-03: the occupation (nurse) is a stereotyping cue for factitious thyrotoxicosis.
21. s23c-s150101-2-2: give the DKA resolution criteria from the 2024 consensus (beta-OHB <0.6 mmol/L and pH ≥7.3 or HCO3 ≥18), not only "anion gap closed"; the SGLT2i stop is 3 days (4 for ertugliflozin), as s150901-2-1 already says.
22. s23c-s150201-2-1: the levothyroxine starting dose with coronary disease is 12.5–25 µg/day.
23. s23c-s150801-1-1: in CAIS, estradiol is at or above the upper male range; and in s23c-s150201-1-1 and s150801-1-1 the PTU and CAH memory aids are close to familiar review-book phrasing (not verbatim); consider rewording.
24. s23c-q150101-2-10 key: add "take correction doses of rapid-acting insulin"; at a glucose of 238 mg/dL, "sugar-containing fluids" is borderline (ADA sick-day guidance advises sugar-free fluids above about 250).

Also see batch 1 defects 1–2 (stale cards.generated.json, no hy spans), which apply to this batch too.

Re-review after the fixes: every item listed above, plus a fresh 15% endocrine sample.
